Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                Consider the following amino acid sequence that is part of a polypeptide X.                             (4)  
  
  
  i) Circle all the peptide bonds in the above sequence. Deduce the total number of amino acids in

  ii) Name the amino acid that is closest to the N terminus and C terminus of the protein.  
  iii) In the sequence provided, box the R groups of the amino acids.  
  iv) Name the amino acid that is hydrophilic and hydrophobic  
1B)                Hibernation, is winter survival strategy in some of the animals like polar bear. Among the following (3)  
  biomolecules, select which of the following is metabolized to provide energy during the hibernation.  
  Justify.  
  i) Cellulose  
  ii) Triglycerides  
  iii) Chitin  
  iv) Phospholipids  
1C)                Researchers in Antartica have discovered fish and other aquatic animals beneath the layer of ice.       (3)  
  Explain if ice did not form hydrogen bonds, what would happen to the fish environment. Justify.  
2A)                The diagram shows three generations of the pedigree of deafness in a family. Is the condition of        (4)  
  deafness in this pedigree inherited as autosomal dominant, autosomal recessive, X-linked  
  dominant, X--linked recessive, or Y linked? Give valid justification to support your answer. Give the  
  genotypes of affected male and unaffected female in the F2 generation.

2B)   In Drosophila melanogaster, there is a dominant gene for gray body color (B) and another dominant (3)  
  gene for normal wings (V). The recessive alleles of those two genes result in black body color (b)  
  and vestigial wings (v), respectively. Flies homozygous for gray body and normal wings were  
  crossed with flies that had black bodies and vestigial wings. The F1 progeny were then test-  
  crossed, with the following output genotypes: BbVv: 236: bbvv: 253: Bbvv: 50: bbVV: 61.  
  i) By looking into the results, would you say that these two genes are linked  
  ii) If so, label the parental and recombinant genotypes.  
  iii) Calculate the recombination frequency and Map distance  
  (1+1+1 = 3 marks)  
  
  
2C)   Hemophilia is a X-linked trait where normal blood clotting trait (XH) is dominant to the hemophilia      (3)  
  allele (X   h)  
  
  i) Give the genotypes of  
  A woman with normal blood clotting whose father had hemophilia  
  A normal man whose father had hemophilia.  
  ii) What is the probability that a marriage between these two individuals will produce a child,  
  regardless of sex, that has hemophilia- Use punnet square to indicate the crossing and offspring?  
  iii) If this couple (XH Xh & XH Y) has a daughter, what is the probability that the daughter will be a  
  carrier of the hemophilia trait? What is the probability a daughter would have hemophilia? What is  
  the probability a son will have hemophilia?

  Determine the amino acid sequences of 2 peptides encoded by the normal and mutant sequences.

  ii) If a sequence of beta globin gene undergoes modification from GAG codon to AAG codon, how

  (2+1 = 3 marks)  
4A)   Identify and explain the mutation in the given sequence of mRNA - A, B and C which is deviating            (3)  
  from the initial original sequence of mRNA.  
  
  
4B)   Industrial melanism is a phenomenon used to describe the evolutionary process in which initially      (3)  
  light-colored organism populations became dark. Industrial melanism affected over 70 species of  
  moths in England. It has been best studied in the peppered moth, Biston betularia. Before 1800,  
  the typical moth species had a light color pattern. Dark-colored melanic moths were rare. During the  
  Industrial Revolution, soot and other industrial wastes darkened tree trunks and killed lichens. With  
  time light-colored moths became rare and dark-colored moths became abundant.  
  i) With the context of evolution, how did the color of the dark-colored melanic moth worked best in  
  their favor?  
  ii) Explain how this passage describes natural selection. Is natural selection the same as  
  adaptation?  
  (1+2 = 3 marks)  
4C)   Survival of the fittest is a popular term that refers to the process of natural selection.                 (4)  
  i) When we say, "survival of the fittest", does it mean that those who are fit only survive, or those  
  that survive are called fit?  
  ii) Are evolution and the survival of the fittest the same concept?  
  (2+2 = 4 marks)  
5A)   Desert areas face acute scarcity of water but few animals have devised novel strategies to save            (3)  
  and utilize water through moist air. Give ANY TWO examples with explanations of how desert

  explanation on how inflatable structures can be made inspired by Nature.  
  (1½+1½ = 3 marks)
